rentalRules.title: How It Works
rentalRules.userRule1: All users must register and verify their identity to rent or list items.
rentalRules.userRule2: Users must provide accurate and truthful information during registration.
rentalRules.listingRule1: Owners must provide clear, accurate descriptions and photos of items.
rentalRules.listingRule2: Items should be clean, in good condition and fit for rental use.
rentalRules.listingRule3: Owners must specify rental prices, rental periods and any special conditions.
rentalRules.listingRule4: Prices for products from evental category are higher than regular one-time rental prices.
rentalRules.itemRule1: Renters must use items as intended and take care of them as if they were their own.
rentalRules.itemRule2: Items must not be altered, damaged or subjected to any misuse.
rentalRules.returnRule1: Items must be returned on or before the agreed rental period ends.
rentalRules.returnRule2: If the order is overdue, a fee of $20 will be charged for each day it is late.
rentalRules.returnRule3: Owners should inspect items upon return and report any issues immediately.
rentalRules.damageRule1: Renters are responsible for any damage or loss during the rental period.
rentalRules.damageRule2: Damage can be evaluated as small, medium or large, with corresponding fees of 10%, 25% and 50% of the item value respectively.
rentalRules.damageRule3: In case of loss or disputes regarding damage, compensation and resolution will be mediated by BlackCircle. Please contact our support at support@blackcircle.com to report your case.
rentalRules.cancellationRule1: The owner or the renter can cancel the order within 12 hours max.
rentalRules.disputeRule1: Any disputes between owners and renters should be reported to the support for mediation.
rentalRules.disputeRule2: The admin will investigate and make a final decision on disputes, which both parties must adhere to.
rentalRules.reviewsRule1: Both owners and renters can leave reviews and ratings after each rental.
rentalRules.reviewsRule2: Honest and respectful feedback helps maintain trust and quality on the BlackCircle.
rentalRules.reviewsRule3: For all new renters and renters with rate less than 4.9 only 7 days rental option will be available.
rentalRules.reviewsRule4: If the renter has not had any rental orders yet or his average rating is less than 4.9, he can rent an item no more than $1000.
rentalRules.reviewsRule5: The renter can rent for $2500 after 3 successful rent with 5 star marks. When the rate of the renter will be 4.9 and bigger he will unlock other feature: ability to rent an item for 14 day period.
rentalRules.reviewsRule6: A review below 3 stars will result in a warning to the renter or owner. Upon receiving such a rating, the user will get an email stating they have received a bad review and must comply with the rental rules. Failure to comply with the rules may result in restricted access to the application.
rentalRules.reviewsRule7: A second review below 3 stars will result in a 30-day suspension for the renter. Upon receiving a second low rating, the user will get an email notifying them of the suspension. During the 30-day suspension period, the rental function will not be available to the user unless manually removed by the admin. The user can appeal this suspension by contacting support at support@blackcircle.com.
rentalRules.platformRule1: BlackCircle is not liable for any loss, damage, or disputes arising from rentals.
rentalRules.platformRule2: BlackCircle will ensure secure payment processing and user verification.
rentalRules.platformRule3: BlackCircle has the right to suspend or terminate accounts for rule violations.
rentalRules.privacyRule1: User data will be handled in accordance with the privacy policy of BlackCircle.
rentalRules.privacyRule2: Personal information will not be shared with third parties without consent.
rentalRules.doNotShowRules: Do not show the rental rules again

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.subtitle: Information about our site
aboutUs.text: Welcome to Black Circle - your ultimate destination for renting fashion items. Explore our extensive collection of clothing, shoes, and accessories available for rent from top vendors. Our platform allows you to browse, select, and rent high-quality items effortlessly. Enjoy flexible rental periods, detailed descriptions, and high-resolution images to make informed decisions. Vendors, join us to reach a broader audience, increase your brand's visibility, and generate additional revenue by renting out your inventory. Embrace sustainable fashion and reduce waste by opting for rental options. Discover the perfect pieces for any occasion without the commitment of purchasing. Shop now and elevate your style with ease.

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Information about our company
company.text: At Black Circle, we are committed to providing a seamless and sustainable rental experience for fashion enthusiasts. Our mission is to make high-quality fashion accessible to everyone while promoting eco-friendly practices. With a focus on customer satisfaction, we offer a diverse range of clothing, shoes, and accessories from renowned vendors. Join our community and enjoy the benefits of fashion without the long-term commitment.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Get in touch with us
contact.text: We're here to help! Whether you have questions about our services, need assistance with your rental, or want to provide feedback, our dedicated support team is ready to assist you. Reach out to us via email, phone, or our online contact form. We value your input and strive to provide prompt and helpful responses to all inquiries.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How can we assist you?
help.text: At Black Circle, we prioritize customer support and aim to make your rental experience as smooth as possible. Our Help section provides comprehensive guides and answers to common questions about our platform, rental process, and policies. If you need further assistance, our support team is always available to offer personalized help and ensure you have a seamless experience.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about Black Circle. Our FAQ section covers topics such as account setup, rental procedures, payment methods, shipping, and returns. We aim to address your concerns and provide detailed information to make your rental experience straightforward and enjoyable. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Shipping Information
shipping.text: Learn about our shipping policies and procedures at Black Circle. We offer reliable and timely shipping options to ensure your rented items arrive in perfect condition. Our shipping information section details our delivery methods, estimated delivery times, and shipping costs. We are committed to providing a hassle-free and efficient shipping experience for all our customers.

rent.title: Rent
rent.subtitle: How to Rent
rent.text: Renting from Black Circle is simple and convenient. Browse our extensive catalog of fashion items, select your desired products, and choose your rental period. Our platform provides clear pricing and rental terms, ensuring a transparent and user-friendly experience. Enjoy the flexibility of wearing high-quality fashion pieces without the commitment of buying. Embrace sustainable fashion with Black Circle today.
